title: Getting Started
description: Meet Dylan, catch up on the story you need, and learn which combat and movement tools matter in your first hours.
intro: New to CONTROL, or returning for Dylan's story? Start with the people and events that matter, then learn the combat rhythm, movement basics and settings that can make the first hours easier.

seo.title: CONTROL Resonant Getting Started Guide | Story & First Steps
seo.description: Start CONTROL Resonant with a spoiler-aware guide to Dylan's story, earlier games, core gameplay, accessibility settings and first-hour priorities.

title: Combat & Builds
description: Choose Aberrant Forms, Combat Abilities, Talents and Artifacts for the fights that give you trouble.
intro: If your build feels weak, first find out why: are you missing openings, running out of power or struggling to close the distance? Work through the combat loop, then change the Form, ability or passive effect that addresses that problem.

seo.title: CONTROL Resonant Combat & Builds Guide | Forms and Abilities
seo.description: Plan CONTROL Resonant builds with Aberrant Forms, Combat Abilities, Talents, Artifacts, parry mechanics and New Game Plus progression choices.

title: Story & Missions
description: Tell the main story from a World Quest or Fault, and follow the named locations and encounters shown so far.
intro: Not sure whether an objective belongs to Dylan's Journey, a World Quest or a Fault? Start with the activity type, then use the Metro Fault and Central Resonant sections when those names appear in your game.

seo.title: CONTROL Resonant Story & Missions | Known Routes
seo.description: Follow CONTROL Resonant's main and optional mission types, with Metro Fault and Central Resonant sections, clear distinctions and spoiler-aware route advice.

title: Completion Planning
description: Keep optional quests, discoveries, boss choices and New Game+ in view without losing the main story.
intro: Want to see more than the main ending? Work out which activities are optional, which movement gates may be worth revisiting and what carries into New Game+. Exact collectible totals and missable routes need a finished-game check.

seo.title: CONTROL Resonant Completion Planning | Bosses & NG+
seo.description: Plan CONTROL Resonant optional quests, boss choices, Artifacts and New Game Plus while keeping track of routes and abilities you may want to revisit.
